cards.text: Text your roommate an apology for eating their clearly labeled leftovers.
Text your boss why you're late. Again.
Comment on your friend's new-haircut photo.
Leave a one-star review for an Airbnb that was clearly haunted.
End a three-month situationship over text.
Apologize for liking their 2014 vacation photo at 2am.
Give a birthday toast for a coworker you have spoken to twice.
Send condolences to a coworker whose houseplant has died.
Apologize to the group chat for spoiling the finale.
Make your case for why you should run the office fantasy league this year.
Email your professor for an extension. The reason involves your cat.
Write to the HOA about your neighbor's suspiciously loud garden gnome.
Write the first paragraph of a cover letter for your dream job. You are wildly unqualified.
Open the wedding speech for your college roommate.
Post a formal apology to the neighborhood listserv regarding the parking incident.
Write a LinkedIn post about a mundane personal triumph. You made toast this morning.
